23028.d: The secret entrance is used to enter Enakhra's Temple during or after the quest Enakhra's Lament.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are several ways to get to the entrances. The entrances and the temple is in the hot desert, so take precautions against the effects of desert heat.
• Go to Shantay Pass and walk south-west from there. The entrances is a long walk from the pass, however.
• A network of magic carpets goes to various locations in the desert. The closest ones to the temple are the Bedabin Camp (walk south from there), monkey colony (walk north and south, requires Do No Evil), Menaphos (walk north), although none of them is particularly close to the temple. Each carpet flight costs as much as 200 coins, although prices are reduced depending upon whether you have complete enough of the Rogue Trader minigame and/or are wearing a ring of charos.
• The Pharaoh's sceptre can teleport to Jaldraocht Pyramid, which is near the entrances. Walk west from the pyramid. The sceptre can be purchased on the Grand Exchange or can be found playing the Pyramid Plunder minigame. The sceptre has three charges, which can be replenished by the Guardian mummy of Pyramid Plunder.
• The camulet teleports to the northeast entrance itself and thus is by far the quickest way to get there. The camulet is an award of the Enakhra's Lament quest. The camulet has four charges, which can be replenished by using a bucket of camel dung on the amulet. If you lose your camulet, you can get another one from Lazim, who is in the temple.
• The Bandit Camp lodestone also works as well, teleport to the bandit camp which is just south west of the entrances (Desert Treasure required).
• Use the enlightened amulet teleport to arrive north of the bandit camp, run the south-east to the temple.

g.label: Boulder
g.how: {{Object map}} on wiki page 'Secret entrance (Enakhra's Temple)'

23029.d: The secret entrance is used to enter Troll Stronghold dungeon during or after the quest Troll Stronghold.
23029.ex: The back way into the stronghold.
23029.loc: South of Troll Stronghold, northeast of Death Plateau

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
Players may reach this location by:
• Teleporting to their house (if in Rellekka) or using a Rellekka tablet.
• Using the Fremennik Province lodestone teleport and running south-east.
• Via the fairy rings, using the code AJR.
• The eagle transport system gets the player a bit to the north of the shortcut.
• Travelling south from the entrance to the underground city of Keldagrim.
• Using the ring of slaying or slayer mask teleport.
• Using the teleports on the Mask of Stone, Mask of Reflection, Mask of Gelatin, Mask of the Kura, Mask of the Aquanites, or their upgraded helm versions. These teleport players to the cockatrice, basilisk, jelly, kurask, and aquanite areas of the dungeon, respectively. Each mask or helm is limited to two teleports per day.
• Using the portals inside one of the chambers on the lower floor of the Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon (assuming that they have fought at least one of the bosses.)
• Using enchanted lyre to teleport south of the entrance to Rellekka and then walk the rest of the way.
• Using elder divination outfit and teleport to sparkling wisp colony.

g.label: Secret Entrance
g.how: {{Object map}} on wiki page 'Secret Entrance (Troll Stronghold)'

23033.d: Secrets of Amberfell is a quest in the Sanguine quest series.

gt.heading: Entering Amberfell
gt.text:
Cross the bridge and follow the path south. On the far side you will be intercepted by Inanna, the guardian spirit of Havenhythe who originally sent you the dream that called you to the land. She will reveal that the message she sent out was meant for nobody in particular, and that you just so happened to be the one to receive it. She will allow you to enter Amberfell, but will refuse to allow Anya entry, calling her a beast. Anya, while offended, agrees to return to her camp for the time being.

Continue along the path to the south and east until you enter the small settlement of Amberfell. Speak with Sorrel, the leader of the village by the well in the centre of the village, who will not be pleased at your arrival. She will suggest that you leave, and that there's nothing for you to do in Amberfell. Head north and speak with Inanna who waits by a tree just outside the village. Inanna will tell you to investigate the village despite Sorrel's protests to find the source of the S.O.S. note.

23077.d: Seers' Village is a small settlement to the west of Camelot.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are multiple ways to get to Seers' Village:
• Walk west from Catherby.
• The Seers' Village lodestone, which must be activated before it can be used.
• Camelot Teleport, a spell requiring 1 law rune and 5 air runes.
• Camelot teleport, a teleport tablet made on a lectern in a player-owned house.
• Fairy rings:
• ALS, which teleports players to McGrubor's Wood.
• CJR, which teleports players west of the Sinclair Mansion.
